gradeNote: Antigravity 构建者 Varun Mohan 的原话，不是用户打满实测。只记录原文，不改 adopted。
author: _mohansolo
originalEnglish:
We’re rolling out a change to increase cache hit rate on Neon by around 4% on Antigravity by massive increasing the cache pool size. This will increase what you can get done in quota by at least 20%.

Will issue a reset after it’s done since it burned quota faster!
followUpEnglish:
More info: The hit rate was particularly bad for workloads where there was more time between model invocatikns (cache was evicted). This should fix that and they should see a much higher improvement.

We will continue to improve this metric globally, sorry for the inconvenience!

leoRestatement.note: 中文转述+Grok 翻译截图。截图时间 02:38 · 11/21/26 对应原帖 18:38Z。口述「额度大概会增加 20%」与原文 at least 20% 一致。以英文原文为准。

whyNotAdopt: 这是产品变更预告，不是配额打满或 token 实测。
「至少 20%」是可完成工作量的宣称，不是新的官方月/周 token 表。
reset 尚未在本轮核到已发生的官方文档页。
